assignmentHtml.task:
全面调查 Sierra & Rhia FAM 的 YouTube 频道。查明以下事项：

  1. 稳定频道 ID 及规范 URL。
  2. 运营方／创作者：Sierra 和 Rhia 是谁？家庭背景。
  3. 频道创建日期，以及目前仍公开的最早上传视频。
  4. 运营地点及频道显示的国家。
  5. 使用的语言。
  6. 主要内容类别。
  7. 内容供应模式。
  8. 代表性系列。提供直接来源 URL。
assignmentHtml.context: 根据 Communitrics 于 2026 年 9 月 2 日的快照，Sierra & Rhia FAM 排名第 15 名，历史累计观看量约为 102B（1020 亿）次。需要可核实的事实，并附来源链接。
assignmentHtml.expected_output: 一份关于 Sierra & Rhia FAM 的结构化资料，包含全部要求的字段，每个字段均附来源 URL。

answerHtml:
Sierra & Rhia FAM — Comprehensive Dossier

  1. STABLE CHANNEL ID & CANONICAL URL
    Channel ID: UCe6n0z9UbsxYCS8P83f84tw. Canonical handle URL: https://www.youtube.com/@SierraRhiaFAM. Legacy ID-based URL: https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCe6n0z9UbsxYCS8P83f84tw [1][2][3].

  2. OPERATORS / CREATORS — Sierra Rose & Rhia Quinn
    The channel is run by two sisters: Sierra Rose (born July 16, 2016, in Toronto, Canada) and her younger sister Rhia Quinn (born 2018–2019). Their parents and account managers are Andrew Endrit (father, real name Endrit Rika) and Anila Grori Rika (mother, born November 11, 1989, in Albania). The family is based in Toronto, Canada. FamousBirthdays confirms the accounts are managed by the parents [4][5][6]. A supplementary channel, Sierra and Rhia English (@sierrarhiaenglish, ~14.4M subscribers), operates alongside the main channel [7].

  3. CREATION DATE & EARLIEST STILL-PUBLIC UPLOAD
    Account created February 4, 2020; first video uploaded February 13, 2020 — titled "Indoor Playground for Kids and Family | kids play" (https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=b-6HzeRTNOk), currently still public with ~27K views [5][8].

  4. OPERATING LOCATION & DISPLAYED COUNTRY
    Operating location: Toronto, Ontario, Canada. Displayed country on YouTube: Canada (CA) [1][2][3][9].

  5. LANGUAGES
    English (primary) [1][2][3].

  6. PRIMARY CONTENT CATEGORY
    Entertainment — specifically a kids/family-oriented channel featuring short stories told by children, everyday moral lessons, pretend play, travel vlogs, and educational content. Wikipedia classifies the channel under "Entertainment" [1][9].

  7. CONTENT SUPPLY MODEL
    Family-led UGC (user-generated content): semi-professional home-produced content managed by the parents, featuring their daughters as on-screen creators. Videos combine long-form vlogs (travel, daily life) and short-form educational/moral-story shorts. The channel's own description states: "a warm and friendly kids channel where short stories are told by children themselves" [10][4].

  8. REPRESENTATIVE SERIES (channel playlists)

  • Sierra and Rhia Vlogs (76 videos) — travel and daily-life vlogs [11]
  • Sierra and Rhia Learn and Play — educational role-play and lesson videos [12]
  • Kids Songs (43 videos) — nursery rhymes and songs [11]

Additional context: As of September 2026, the channel ranks approximately #14–15 among most-viewed YouTube channels worldwide with roughly 102B lifetime views and ~53.6M subscribers [1][10][9].
